cards.card_text: His servants Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer strike him down at Beth-millo, on the road down to Silla.
cards.verse_text: His servants Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer struck him down, and he died.
